Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::reviewCheckingAccount(): CheckingAccount {
	definition:
		currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequest,
		obs: Set(LoanRequest) = LoanRequest.allInstance()->select(o|o.RequestID = currentLoanRequest.RequestID)
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		obs.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		let ob: CheckingAccount in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(currentLoanRequest)
}
